coach_verdict: Execute Priority 1 today: Aerobic Base Cycling with High-Cadence Spin-Ups. Given your 6-day training hiatus and low CTL, launching straight into high-impact running or max Z5 efforts carries unnecessary injury risk. A structured Z2 bike session safe-starts your load accumulation, stimulates mitochondrial adaptation, and respects the 70% base rule.

priority_1.intensity: Zone 2 (145-185W / HR 125-145 bpm) with Zone 4 spin-ups
priority_1.workout_details: 10 min Z1 warm-up. 45 min Z2 steady power at 85-95 RPM. Insert 5x30 sec high-cadence spin-ups (>110 RPM) at Zone 4 power (235-255W) with 90 sec Z2 recovery between efforts. 5 min Z1 cool-down.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority to safely kickstart your CTL progression from 12.9 without high mechanical impact. Re-establishes aerobic baseline and motor unit recruitment.

priority_2.intensity: Zone 2 to Low Zone 3 (HR 135-155 bpm / RPE 5-6)
priority_2.workout_details: 10 min easy warm-up jog + dynamic mobility. 30 min steady Zone 2 running on flat terrain, finishing with 4x100m stride-outs at 5km target pace (focus on quick leg turnover and tall posture). 5 min walking cool-down.
priority_2.reason: Secondary option targeting 5km running goals while keeping overall load manageable and adhering to the 70% low-intensity pyramidal distribution.

priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 min jump rope + mobility. 4 sets x 6 reps Barbell Back Squats (70-80% 1RM), 4 sets x 6 reps Romanian Deadlifts, 3 sets x 8 Heavy Sandbag Clean & Presses (70kg), 3 sets x 45 sec Plank variations.
priority_3.reason: Tertiary option to build force production, lower-body torque for cycling FTP gains, and postural durability, preserving aerobic capacity for upcoming quality sessions.
